evidence.claim: City 'Current development applications' list has no entry for any Watson Parkway North address except 115 Watson Pkwy N (OZS24-015); no Bagot Street entry.

Searches for "126 Bagot Street" and "124 Bagot Street" Guelph plus Bagot St development/ZBA/site plan/minor variance returned no application, assembly, sale or listing for these lots (only unrelated Bagot St condo/house listings e.g. 107 Bagot, 12 Bagot, 112 Bagot rental).

Zoning check: R.1B (1995 by-law single detached) -> RM.5 (2023 by-law, medium density) could not be confirmed at parcel level; whole 2023 by-law described as under OLT appeal (not in force), so stricter of old/new (R.1B) applies until resolved. Engine shows 4 buildings on 1,329 m2 across 2 addresses - possible legal non-conforming/multi-unit use; not verified.

summary: No application, assembly, sale or listing found for 124/126 Bagot St in city lists or web search; MLS/title/heritage/permits unchecked. R.1B->RM.5 unverified and appealed by-law, so 13 units is a bylaw ceiling only (4 existing buildings on a 2-lot pair; ownership of both lots must be confirmed).
